data.title: SH3BP4 is a negative regulator of amino acid-Rag GTPase-mTORC1 signaling
data.authors: Kim YM; Stone M; Hwang TH; Kim YG; Dunlevy JR; Griffin TJ; Kim DH

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.abstract_excerpt: Amino acids stimulate cell growth and suppress autophagy through activation of mTORC1. The activation of mTORC1 by amino acids is mediated by Rag guanosine triphosphatase (GTPase) heterodimers on the lysosome. The molecular mechanism by which amino acids regulate the Rag GTPase heterodimers remains to be elucidated. Here, we identify SH3 domain-binding protein 4 (SH3BP4) as a binding protein and a negative regulator of Rag GTPase complex.
